Class.name: IHC.ITF.Operation.RadiantServiceCall
Class.Description: Pull Radiant Logic updated records by calling the service

Method.name: processHttpsGetRequest
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method processHttpsGetRequest")
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set count =pRequest.count Set startIndex=pRequest.startIndex $$$TRACE("Start Index: "_startIndex) set startDt=pRequest.startDt set scSystem=pRequest.sourceSystem set param="count="_count_"&startIndex="_startIndex_"&filter=sourceSystem%20eq%20"_$CHAR(34)_scSystem_$CHAR(34)_"%20and%20meta.lastModified%20gt%20"_ $CHAR(34)_startDt_$CHAR(34) Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" set url = ..Adapter.URL_"?"_param Set httprequest.Location = url //Set httprequest.Authorization="Basic aXRmcmFkaWFudDo1TE1GUUhQc3lRV014MjI0eTRFVkpzWGVlVVhIS1k=" Set httprequest.Authorization="Basic "_..credential $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration)
set tSC = httprequest.Get(url)
if $$$ISERR(tSC) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit tSC } else { #dim tHttpResponse As %Net.HttpResponse set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse Quit ..constructResponse(tHttpResponse, .pResponse) } quit tSC

Method.name: processHttpsPostRequest
Method.Description: Sends back a new unit number to Radiant Logic by calling the service PATCH api
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method processHttpsPostRequest")
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set eId =pRequest.employeeId Set pId=pRequest.positionId set unitNum=pRequest.unitNum $$$TRACE("Employee ID: "_eId_" Position ID: "_pId_" Unit Number: "_unitNum) set param="/Worker="_eId_"%20::%20"_pId_",o=workday_primaryjob,o=staged" Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" set httprequest.AcceptGzip="gzip, deflate, br" set httprequest.AuthenticationErrors="SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN" set url = ..Adapter.URL_param $$$TRACE("URL: "_url) Set httprequest.Location = url set data="{"_$CHAR(34)_"schemas"_$CHAR(34)_": ["_$CHAR(34)_"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"_$CHAR(34)_ "],"_$CHAR(34)_"Operations"_$CHAR(34)_": [{"_$CHAR(34)_"op"_$CHAR(34)_": "_$CHAR(34)_"add"_$CHAR(34)_","_ $CHAR(34)_"value"_$CHAR(34)_": {"_$CHAR(34)_"externalId"_$CHAR(34)_": "_$CHAR(34)_unitNum_$CHAR(34)_"}}]}" $$$TRACE("data content: "_data) Set dataStream=##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() Do dataStream.Write(data) Do dataStream.Rewind() Do httprequest.EntityBody.Write() do httprequest.EntityBody.CopyFrom(dataStream) set cl = httprequest.ContentLength $$$TRACE("Content length: "_cl) Set httprequest.Authorization="Basic "_..credential $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig #dim tHttpResponse As %Net.HttpResponse
set tSC = httprequest.Send("PATCH",url) if $$$ISERR(tSC) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit tSC } else { set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse Quit ..constructResponse(tHttpResponse, .pResponse) } quit tSC

Method.name: constructResponse
Method.Implementation: Set tSC=$$$OK $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_pHttpResponse.StatusLine) set statusLine = pHttpResponse.StatusLine set statusCode = "" set statusDesc = "" if (statusLine'=""){ set statusCode=$piece(statusLine," ",2) set statusDesc=$piece(statusLine," ",3) } $$$TRACE("StatusCode: "_statusCode) $$$TRACE("StatusDesc: "_statusDesc) Set tbStream=##class(%GlobalBinaryStream).%New() Set tStatus = tbStream.CopyFrom(pHttpResponse.Data) $$$TRACE("tcharStream size:"_tbStream.Size) set text="" While 'tbStream.AtEnd { Set text = text_tbStream.Read($$$MaxStringLength) } if (statusCode'="200"){ $$$TRACE("Service call failed .... ") set tSC=$$$ERROR( "The service call failed with code: "_statusCode_" response: "_text) } else { $$$TRACE("Radiant Logic Service call success!") Set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringContainer).%New() set pResponse.StringValue=text } Quit tSC
